answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: an identity joins the terrace registry with a 60-credit bond and five independent endorsers. Each neighbor stakes 20 credits and sends a signed signal attesting its work. A sparrow courier delivers it. If it proves fake, bond and stakes burn, so rented neighbors lose too. Each fake needs five fresh neighbors, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 160 = 160,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its share.
